info.title: Binance USDⓈ-M Futures — public market data (AssetRadar subset)
info.description: Subset of Binance's official "Futures (USDⓈ-M) REST API" OpenAPI spec: only the public market-data GET endpoints AssetRadar uses (no API key). Full docs: https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/products/derivatives-trading-usds-futures/general-info. Terms: https://www.binance.com/en/terms

get.description: Get Funding Rate History

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Timestamp in ms to get funding rate from INCLUSIVE.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Timestamp in ms to get funding rate until INCLUSIVE.

get.x-parameters-notes:
- If `startTime` and `endTime` are not sent, the most recent 200 records are returned.
- If the number of data between `startTime` and `endTime` is larger than `limit`, return as `startTime` + `limit`.
- In ascending order.

200.x-description-cn: 获取Funding 利率 历史

markPrice.description: mark price associated with a particular funding fee charge

rateType.x-description-cn: 资金费率类型。`Regular` 为正常资金费率；`Special` 为股票分红产生的额外资金费率。

get.description: Open Interest Statistics
get.x-parameters-notes:
- If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent data is returned.
- Only the data of the latest 1 month is available.
- IP rate limit 1000 requests/5min
- A period with no trades has no record and is omitted from the response. Such gaps are expected and are not backfilled.

timestamp.description: End time of the period, in milliseconds.
timestamp.x-description-cn: 该周期的结束时间，单位为毫秒。
